Feel the roar of the engines in Las Vegas as the World Finals reach a fever pitch during an unforgettable freestyle session. Dennis Anderson sets a punishing pace, driving on the "ragged edge" with relentless intensity , while Todd LeDuc risks it all in Metal Militia with massive air and back-to-back backflips. From the high-stakes pressure of "bonus time" maneuvers to the incredible "wow factor" of four-second hang times, this competition demonstrates exactly what championships are made of.

Step into the high-stakes world of stadium competition where the obstacles are larger than life and the rivalries are legendary. Watch as a teenage Ryan Anderson, the reigning Rookie of the Year, attempts to carve his own legacy in the "big field" with a fearless driving style that pushes his truck to the absolute limit. The intensity reaches a fever pitch when nine-time world champion Tom Meents brings Maximum Destruction to the track, battling mechanical failures and tire damage to deliver a performance only a veteran can provide. From technical saves and massive air to the relentless pursuit of the Freestyle lead, this episode captures the raw power and "blood rhythm" of drivers who refuse to cut back for their fans.
